answer: File a voyage manifest before each epoch: its planned actions, hashed on-chain. Post a 1,000 POA bond that unlocks in terraces, 250 POA per honest epoch, full release after four. Each epoch a gale audit boards 5% of manifests at random; any gap between manifest and behavior slashes the whole bond. Running 50 Sybil sailors locks 50,000 POA for a full month; 2 to 3 gale boardings expected per epoch, each burning a 1,000 POA bond. Honest agents sail free and clear. Like a harbor master boarding 1 ship in 20 at random: smugglers never know which voyage gets searched.
